title: Auto-failover triggered
regex: auto_failover:.*(Failing over|Could not automatically fail over|failover.*node)
meaning: Auto-failover engine acted or refused to act. Read the reason line and the node's health just before it.
next: Open the Timeline at this time, +/- 2m, files info/error/memcached.

title: Failover requested (REST or auto)
regex: Starting failover of nodes|Failover of inactive nodes|Failover completed successfully
meaning: Failover started or completed. Cross-check the caller in the Access tab (POST /controller/failOver).
next: Access tab: pattern 'controller/failOver', group by client.

title: Rebalance failed or stopped
meaning: A rebalance ended abnormally. The reason term names the failing service or bucket.
next: Search the same node for the reason term; check rebalance_report_*.json.

title: ns_server process crash report
regex: CRASH REPORT|crash_report|\*\* Generic server .* terminating|Server .* terminating
meaning: An Erlang process died. The first crash in the window is usually the cause, later ones are fallout.
next: Timeline from the first hit, +/- 1m.

title: Out-of-memory (OS or process)
regex: Out of memory|oom-kill|Killed process|Cannot allocate memory
meaning: The kernel or a service ran out of memory.
next: Check couchbase.log memory sections and cgroup limits.

title: memcached exited or restarted
meaning: KV process went down. Look at the exit status and memcached.log just before it.
next: Timeline on memcached.log and babysitter.log.

title: memcached fatal / assertion
meaning: Crash signature in memcached.log; minidump may be in the collection.
next: Check for *.dmp files and the log tail.

title: Disk full or write errors
regex: No space left on device|ENOSPC|Disk write failed
meaning: Out of disk space.
next: df section in couchbase.log.

title: Node marked unhealthy / unreachable
meaning: Cluster manager lost contact with a node.
next: Check network and CPU/memory at that time.

title: DCP connection errors
meaning: DCP stream problems affect replication, indexing and XDCR.
next: Group by connection name in Search.

title: memcached slow operations
meaning: Operations exceeded the slow threshold. Check bucket, command and duration.
next: Search 'Slow operation' and look at the cid and duration.

title: Connection limit hit
regex: Too many open connections|Reached connection limit|No more connections
meaning: Clients exhausted the connection budget.
next: Check per-bucket connection stats.

title: Bucket warmup / slow start
meaning: Warmup events with durations.
next: Compare warmup duration to data size.

title: XDCR connectivity errors
regex: Connectivity Errors = \[\{|ERRO GOXDCR.*(connection refused|i/o timeout|no such host|dial tcp)
meaning: goxdcr cannot reach the target.
next: Read the targetNode and error text, then check TLS and DNS.

title: XDCR TLS / certificate errors
regex: TLS handshake failed|x509:|tls: (bad|failed|handshake)|certificate (has expired|signed by unknown|is not valid)
meaning: Certificate or TLS handshake failures.
next: Compare cert expiry and SAN to the host name used.

title: XDCR pipeline stopped / restarted
meaning: Replication pipeline lifecycle events.
next: Timeline on goxdcr.log around the first hit.

title: XDCR changes_left (backlog samples)
meaning: Backlog above 100k mutations per sample.
next: Check docs_written vs docs_processed over time.

title: XDCR target collection missing
regex: ^(?!.*Stats for pipeline).*(unknown collection|UNKNOWN_COLLECTION|ErrorUnknownCollection|target collection .*(not found|does not exist))
meaning: Mapped collections are absent on the target.
next: Compare goxdcr_replications.json mapping to target collections.

title: Indexer errors / panics
meaning: Indexer process errors.
next: Timeline on indexer.log and projector.log.

title: Index rollback to zero
meaning: Index rolled back, often after failover.
next: Correlate with failover time.

title: Query service errors / timeouts
meaning: Query engine errors.
next: Check completed_requests and system:active_requests.

title: Eventing errors
meaning: Eventing handler or service errors.
next: Read the handler name and exception text.

title: Search (FTS) errors
meaning: FTS errors or panics.
next: Check cbft logs for index name.

title: Authentication failures
meaning: Bad credentials or expired tokens.
next: Access tab: group by client and user for 401.

title: Certificate warnings
regex: certificate.*(will expire|has expired|is expired)|x509: certificate has expired
meaning: Certificate expiry warnings or failures. Compare the expiry timestamp in the line to the log time range.
next: Check cert not-after dates.

title: CPU throttling or cgroup limits
meaning: Container CPU throttling counters in cgroup stats.
next: Compare to CPU limit in pod spec.

title: HTTP 5xx on REST
meaning: Server errors returned to REST callers.
next: Access tab: pattern '" 5', group by endpoint.
